title: Maggi Masala Powder
subtitle: A unified spice blend for Maggi noodles and more — tuned so overlapping spices don't double up.
protein: One batch seasons ~16–18 dishes — keeps 3–4 months at room temp

method.title: Measure everything into one bowl
items: Use a large dry bowl — everything goes in together
Measure {@coriander} first — it's your visual anchor, everything else is much smaller relative to it
Add {@jeera}, {@chili}, {@turmeric}
Add {@chaat} and {@garam}
Add {@ginger}, {@aamchur}, {@pepper} — kept small because the chaat and garam masala already carry pepper, cumin, ginger and salt
Add {@cornflour}, {@sugar}, {@hing}, {@salt} — aamchur stands in for citric acid, hing adds Jain depth

method.title: Mix, then taste dry
items: Whisk or stir with a dry spoon for at least 1 minute
No streaks of turmeric yellow or chili red should be visible when done
Final color should be a warm reddish-brown — not orange, not dark brown
Take a tiny pinch — rub between fingers and taste dry before jarring
You should get: sour hit first, then warmth, then mild heat, savory salt undertone
If something feels off, see the taste tuning tip below before transferring to the jar

method.title: Jar, label and store
items: Use a completely dry 8 oz glass jar with a tight-sealing lid
Funnel or spoon the blend in — tap to settle, don't pack it down
Never close the lid if anything is warm — moisture causes clumping
Label with: Maggi Masala · date made · v1 — track adjustments batch to batch
Keep in a cool, dark spot away from the stove — 3–4 months at room temperature, up to 6 months refrigerated in a sealed bag
Always scoop with a dry spoon; clumping means moisture got in — break it up and use within 2 weeks

method.title: How much to use
items: Maggi noodles: 1–1½ tsp per adult serving
Stir-fried vegetables or sabji: 1 tsp per 2 servings
Paneer marinade: 1½ tsp per 200g; roasted paneer or peanuts: ¾–1 tsp per batch
Chaat sprinkle or raita seasoning: ½ tsp to taste

method.label: Toddler note
items: Use ¼ tsp maximum per toddler serving — chaat masala and chili make this moderately spiced
For her Maggi bowl: cook noodles plain, season her portion separately with ¼ tsp
Stir in small cubed boiled carrot or potato for added nutrition and bulk

method.label: Taste tuning (after first cooked use)
method.text: Too spicy: stir in a little more coriander powder to dilute this jar; reduce chili next batch. Not sour enough: add more aamchur — it adds tang without extra salt. Tastes flat: add a touch more hing, the umami anchor here. Bitter aftertaste: usually the turmeric or over-toasted jeera — make sure roasted jeera is store-bought, not home-toasted past golden. Too salty: your chaat masala brand is likely running salty — use less per serving rather than fixing the jar.
